overview_description.description:
Invoice Bazaar is a Fintech operating company that is focused on the financial inclusion of under-served Small and Mid-sized Enterprises (SME) to cash their receivables early, thereby helping them with working capital.Invoice Bazaar was founded in 2016 by Anand Nagaraj, a former Citi Executive and was poised to provide financing to underbanked and unbanked SMEs, including women-led enterprises, Invoice Bazaar meaning “market of invoices” was an attempt to bridge the supplier-buyer relationship, by digitizing the transactions which are done manually in the real world. This digitization helps in providing finance to a supplier by actually taking buyer-risk. 
Invoice Bazaar was acquired in 2021 by Triterras, a Singapore based Trade and Trade Finance fintech that was listed on NASDAQ (TRIT) through the SPAC route. Invoice Bazaar continues to be part of Triterras Group. In 2023, Triterras sold Invoice Bazaar to a group entity called Tritfin Pte Ltd. Invoice Bazaar continues to run as an independent entity managed by Triterras.

product.name: Invoice Bazaar Supply Chain Finance (SCF) Platform
product.description: A platform that allows early payment to SME suppliers of large corporate clients, providing extended payment terms to the corporate.

product.name: Invoice Finance
product.description: A service that enables SMEs to receive early payment on invoices raised on large customers, with financing available for up to 90 days.

product.name: eCommerce Finance
product.description: Provides finance based on online delivery sales performance, requiring authorization to access sales data from platforms like Zomato and Deliveroo.

product.name: Payment Gateway Finance
product.description: Offers finance based on sales performance on payment gateways, requiring authorization to access sales data from PayTabs.

product.name: Inventory Finance
product.description: Provides a vendor finance line against inventory as collateral, helping businesses with working capital for supplier payments.

product.name: Amazon Seller Finance
product.description: Offers finance to Amazon sellers based on sales, inventory, and performance data, requiring authorization to access Amazon Seller Central data.
